ios.desc:
Your receipts, organized effortlessly.

Just scan a receipt with your camera and ReceiptBin fills in the details for you—merchant, date, total, tax, and line items. You can also track mileage, organize with categories and tags, and export whenever you need.

FEATURES

Autofill: Just point your camera at a receipt. Merchant, date, total, tax, tip, currency, and line items fill in automatically. Everything works right on your device.

Mileage Tracking: Record your drive and ReceiptBin measures the distance using GPS. You can even watch your trip from your Lock Screen with Live Activity. Set up your vehicles and rates, or log trips manually. Your mileage appears in your reports along with your receipts.

Categories and Tags: Create your own categories, tags, and payment methods. Organize by project, client, deduction type, or whatever works best for you.

Full-Text Search: Every word on your receipts is indexed. Search for a product name, amount, or even "warranty" and find it fast. You can also filter by category, tag, date range, or payment method.

Reports: Export your data as PDF or CSV. Filter by date, category, or tag. You can include receipt images either embedded or as a separate ZIP file.

Email Import: Get your own forwarding address. Just send email receipts there and they’ll appear in the app, already filled in.

YNAB Integration: Connect your YNAB account and link receipts to your transactions. The receipt link appears in the transaction memo, so proof of purchase is just one tap away from your budget.

AND ALSO
• iCloud Sync across all your devices
• Multi-page scanning for long receipts and invoices
• Spotlight search from your home screen
• Siri Shortcuts support
• Share extension to save receipts from other apps
• Home screen widgets
• Recently deleted folder (30 days)
• Archive for receipts you want to keep but tuck away

PRIVACY

Autofill works entirely on your device. Your trips and routes stay on your device and in your iCloud. Your location is never sent to our servers. No account needed.

PRICING

ReceiptBin is free. Autofill, categories, tags, manual mileage logging, YNAB, and iCloud sync are all included. Upgrade to ReceiptBin Plus to unlock cloud autofill, email import, reports, and GPS trip recording.

quotes.text:
I built ReceiptBin because I wanted a simple way to track receipts and link them to my budgeting app. There are plenty of apps that already do this, but most of them feel out of place on iOS and lock basic features like OCR and autofill behind paywalls.
ReceiptBin uses Apple’s VisionKit and Foundation Models to handle OCR and autofill at no cost. Everything syncs through iCloud, and you can generate reports entirely on-device. There’s also support for widgets and Siri Shortcuts.

If you want to check it out: https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/receiptbin/id6761148891

I’m planning to push another update in the next few weeks with bug fixes and some new functionality.
